marco: Quick follow-up from the Aurora dedicated postmortem. Root cause: repeated VPC peering route churn + on-prem NAT/conntrack exhaustion + a control-plane replication race that left routes stale. Created JIRA RED-940. Dropping owners + next steps below.

alyssa: I'll own peering hardening. Plan: enable BFD (300ms/3), lower BGP keepalives, add session debounce (hold-time 20s) and implement soft-restart-friendly teardown. ETA: Tue EOD.

deepak: I'll take the replication race. Patch in branch `fix/route-atomic-apply` 1 needs review. Implementation will add `route_applied_at` guard column and idempotent apply semantics; small migration + rolling restart required.

ru: I'll do on-prem runbook + customer comms. Need conntrack guidance, sample tuning, and a recommended maintenance window from accounts. Tentative window 2026-04-07 02:00-04:00 UTC.

caro: I'll add monitoring and alerting. New metrics: `bgp_peers_flap_count`, `conntrack_usage_pct`, `route_repl_lag_ms`. Alert rules: flap_count > 3 in 1h -> page oncall; conntrack_usage_pct > 85% -> page. Dashboard panel linked to postmortem.

ops-bot: Channel #incident-aurora-1734506789 created. JIRA RED-940 linked. Canary playbook attached.

marco: Owners assigned: peering -> @alyssa, replication -> @deepak, runbook/comm -> @ru, observability -> @caro. Add weekly post-rollout checks for 4 weeks.

alyssa: Test plan excerpt: stage to dedicated-staging, run `peering-flapper --interval=5s --duration=600s`, validate BFD suppression and that debounce prevents teardown. Upload logs to RED-940.

deepak: Note on migration: `ALTER TABLE routes ADD COLUMN route_applied_at TIMESTAMP NULL;` migration in branch. Will coordinate canary and rolling restart with @marco.

ru: Runbook items: document conntrack dump commands and thresholds. Sample commands to capture during incidents: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <cust-ip> and port 179 -w /tmp/bgp.pcap` and `sudo conntrack -S > /tmp/conntrack.stats`. Adding fallback NAT gateway config snippet.

caro: Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/aurora-isolation. Created alert playbook with runbook links.

marco: Timeline recap: alyssa (peering PR + tests), deepak (replication PR + migration + canary), ru (runbook + customer comms + window), caro (alerts + dashboard). Target: next Fri COB. Weekly check-ins for 4 weeks post-rollout.

alyssa: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/networking/pull/446

deepak: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/3471

ru: ack. Draft comms sent to accounts; holding until canary windows confirmed.

caro: ack. Alerts wired and tested in staging.

marco: Ops addition 1 add an "isolation_evidence" checklist to the postmortem: BGP pcap, conntrack dump, route table snapshot, and control-plane logs. Example capture commands included in runbook.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: PR reviewer ping in 48h.

marco: We'll review progress at the incident retro on Mon 2026-03-31. Please keep RED-940 updated with PRs, test results, and confirmed customer windows. :white_check_mark:
